messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — onboarding run for magnet-40b (int4) showed a context folding/coil after a very long prefix, outputs start repeating tokens and semantics drift. Repro command below, pinging eng-ml and infra.
maria: `./run_inference.sh --model magnet-40b --quant int4 --prompt long_prefill.txt --max-tokens 120000 --seed 42`
jia: Can you paste the smallest log excerpt where the repetition starts? also which kernel/commit?
maria: log snippet (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-20 03:12:06] KVCACHE: append idx=65536 -> mapped_idx=0
[2026-03-20 03:12:06] ROPE: phase_wrap at pos=32768 -> resetting to 0
[2026-03-20 03:12:07] TOKEN_GEN: token 98214 == token 98215 (repeat)
``` 
maria: commit: `serving-runtime@b1c4d2e`, kernels: `fused-attn-int4-v2`
leo: :eyes: that mapping idx->0 looks like wraparound. RoPE phase wrap at 32768 aligns with old 16k/32k block arithmetic; int4 kernels may have truncated the position scale or used a 16-bit counter somewhere.
leo: Could be a window-coalescence bug where sharded kv indices are coalesced into a smaller address space on quantized paths.
anika: Suggest enabling the kvcache debug flag and running smaller sweep: `KVCACHE_DEBUG=1 ./run_inference.sh ... --prefill-lengths 32k,64k,96k`
maria: Started a quick debug run with that flag, attaching an excerpt: `kvcache fingerprint mismatch at prefill=98304 (expected fp=0x9a7f, got 0x9a7f) but index remap != expected`
devbot: Run job magnet-40b-int4-1713141600 queued by maria
jia: Does fp16 behave? we should compare int4 vs fp16 to see if this is quant-specific.
maria: fp16 run looks stable on same prompt — divergence point not observed up to 120k tokens. int4 diverges consistently around token 98,213.
leo: Ok — plan: 1) run int4 with `ROTARY_POS_STORE=64` patch to avoid 16k wrap shorthand, 2) run int4 with fallback to int8 kernels, 3) add a unit test that sweeps prefills and asserts no kv index remap. I'll open a quick PR for the test and kernel toggle.
anika: I'll run the three variants overnight and post results in morning. tagging @infra-sre in case we need a microkernel hotfix: `@infra-sre please advise if fused-attn-int4-v2 has known pos-index truncation` :pray:
jia: If this is reproducible, we should add it to onboarding checklist for quantized models (prefill sweep + kvconsistency check).
maria: Agreed. I'll attach the minimal repro (prompt + seed + exact commit) to the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
leo: If you want, I can try bisecting the kernel change order tomorrow morning.
anika: thanks — doing runs now, will report status in this thread.
jia: ack :eyes:
